AssayDetails: Pooled buffer scrub samples from female leg skin. The samples are from individuals with dry and non-dry skin following treatment with Dove branded products.
objectives: To carry out metagenomic analyses of pooled samples from leg skin buffer scrubs obtained from individuals with dry and non-dry skin following treatment with Dove branded products. This will provide information not only on the taxa present in the samples but also any functional characteristics enabling taxanomic and functional comparisons between the products
